title: High latency calling an upstream service
symptoms: p95 latency above 2s for the checkout service. Upstream request timeout after 5000ms. Latency rises across all endpoints that depend on one downstream API.
root_cause: A downstream dependency is slow (overloaded, degraded network or slow third party), and callers wait on it.
impact: Users see slow pages; timeouts can cascade into errors and retries.
fix_steps: Use tracing or logs to find which upstream call got slow.
Check that service's health, CPU and recent deploys.
Enable a circuit breaker or fallback, and lower timeouts so threads are not tied up.
prevention: Set timeouts and circuit breakers on all outbound calls and alert on per-dependency latency.
